tools.name: find_clinics
tools.description: Find clinics near a place, in a town or by name, nearest first. Each clinic has its clinic_id, address, distance, phone numbers with call/SMS/WhatsApp channels, hours today, open now and rating. Give near (latitude/longitude) or place (a town, place name or four-digit postal code). With treatment_id, only clinics that offer it now, with their price from.

query.description: A clinic name or a town. A town without a clinic of that name is searched as a place.

near.description: A position. It wins over place.

place.description: A town or place name ("Asker", "Lierskogen") or a four-digit postal code ("3420").

treatment_id.description: Only clinics that offer this treatment now.

open_now.description: Only clinics open at this moment (Europe/Oslo).

open_on.description: Only clinics open on this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: get_clinic
tools.description: One clinic's facts: address, phones, the week's opening hours (also odd and even weeks), closed days, parking, team, treatment categories with prices, current offers, payment methods, cancellation notice, gift cards and subscriptions.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

tools.name: find_practitioners
tools.description: Find a practitioner by name (at least two letters) and the clinics where each can be booked now. For who can do one treatment option, with prices, use get_booking_choices.

query.description: At least two letters of the practitioner name.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

tools.name: search_treatments
tools.description: Search treatments in Norwegian and English at once; spelling mistakes and compound words are handled. Each result has its treatment_id, category path, price from-to, offer price, duration, clinic count and, with near or place, the nearest clinics. Filter by category, body_area or skin_concern (browse_site lists them). Treatments no clinic can book now are left out unless include_unbookable is true. Without a match: suggestions and categories.

query.description: Treatment words in Norwegian or English. Leave empty to browse.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

near.description: A position. It wins over place.

place.description: A town or place name ("Asker", "Lierskogen") or a four-digit postal code ("3420").

category.description: A category slug from browse_site, or its slug path ("ansikt/laser").

body_area.description: A body area slug from browse_site.

skin_concern.description: A skin concern slug from browse_site.

max_price_nok.description: Only treatments with a price from at most this.

on_offer.description: Only treatments with an active offer.

include_unbookable.description: Also treatments no clinic can book now.

tools.name: get_treatment
tools.description: One treatment: what it is, the procedure, recovery and safety, sessions and interval, its options with option_id, price, offer price and duration, the clinics that offer it and its reviews. Every option has a booking_url.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

near.description: A position. It wins over place.

place.description: A town or place name ("Asker", "Lierskogen") or a four-digit postal code ("3420").

tools.name: get_booking_choices
tools.description: The choices the booking lightbox offers for one option_id. Without a clinic: every clinic that can book it, with distance, practitioner count and prices. With clinic_id: the practitioners with their own prices (practitioner_id), add-ons, packages, party size, cancellation notice and payment methods.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

near.description: A position. It wins over place.

place.description: A town or place name ("Asker", "Lierskogen") or a four-digit postal code ("3420").

tools.name: find_free_days
tools.description: Which days have a free time for one option_id, for up to 60 days, at clinic_id or at the three nearest clinics to near or place. For one practitioner_id or anyone; add_on_ids lengthen the visit. No free day gives a waitlist_url.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

near.description: A position. It wins over place.

place.description: A town or place name ("Asker", "Lierskogen") or a four-digit postal code ("3420").

add_on_ids.description: Add-on ids from get_booking_choices. Their minutes lengthen each time.

tools.name: find_free_times
tools.description: The free times on a date (or up to 7 days) for one option_id at clinic_id, with the practitioners free at each time and their prices. Every time has a booking_url that opens the booking lightbox with the option, practitioner, day, time and add-ons chosen. A time is not held until the person books it.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

from_date.description: First day of a range (YYYY-MM-DD); default today.

add_on_ids.description: Add-on ids from get_booking_choices. Their minutes lengthen each time.

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: The live offers (campaigns), with each treatment or product, its price before and after, and until when it holds. Filter by clinic_id, item_type or item_slug; offer_id reads one offer.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

item_slug.description: Offers on this treatment or product.

offer_id.description: One offer with all its items.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search skincare and retail products: GLØDI's marketplace on glodi.no and each clinic's shop on its own site. Filter by brand, category or stock. product_id reads one product with its description, sellers, subscription options, matching treatments and reviews.

query.description: Product, brand or ingredient words in Norwegian or English. Leave empty to browse.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

category.description: A product category name or slug.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Upcoming arrangements and courses, GLØDI's own and the clinics', with sessions, seats left, price from and registration state. event_id reads one event with its program, prerequisites and price tiers.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

from_date.description: Only sessions from this day (YYYY-MM-DD); default today.

tools.name: list_reviews
tools.description: Published reviews and their summary (average, count, distribution) for one clinic_id, practitioner, treatment_id or product_id.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

tools.name: browse_site
tools.description: The map of everything public here: every list page with its count, and the treatment categories, body areas and skin concerns with their slugs, for vague needs ("pigmentering", "acne"). Also the contact facts. GLØDI's own offer for clinics is glodi_for_business.

tools.name: read_public_page
tools.description: Read one public page, normally a URL another answer returned: its text sections, links, schema.org facts and typed data for the page type (clinic, treatment, practitioner, offer, product, brand, event, guide, article, ingredient or job).

url.description: A public page URL, normally one another answer returned.

tools.name: glodi_for_business
tools.description: GLØDI's offer for clinics and practitioners (glodi.no/bedrift): every module with what it does, its features, its monthly price and how modules combine (levels, included and free modules, the base module); GLØDI Platinum; the subscription terms (VAT, monthly billing, notice, no minimum term); usage prices such as SMS; and how to apply or try the demo.

tools.name: price_modules
tools.description: The monthly price of a set of modules (module_id from glodi_for_business) as GLØDI invoices it: each line, modules included at 0 kr, the base module added when the others need it, a public promo code, VAT, and an apply_url with these modules chosen.

module_ids.description: module_id values from glodi_for_business, for example booking and journal.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book one free time for a person, paid at the clinic. Give option_id, clinic_id, date and time from find_free_times, and the person's name and mobile number (practitioner_id and add_on_ids if chosen). Nothing is booked yet: a code goes to the person by SMS, and the answer has the price, the place and the cancellation notice. Tell the person these and that the clinic's terms apply, ask for the code, then call confirm_with_code.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

date.description: The day (YYYY-MM-DD) of a free time find_free_times returned.

time.description: The start (HH:MM) of a free time find_free_times returned.

practitioner_id.description: A practitioner free at that time; omit for the first one free.

add_on_ids.description: Add-on ids from get_booking_choices. Their minutes lengthen each time.

package_id.description: A package_id from get_booking_choices: the visit is the first session of the package.

guest_names.description: The other guests, for a treatment booked for several guests at once (party_size above 1).

name.description: The person's full name, as they say it.

phone.description: The person's mobile number. The code goes there by SMS.

note.description: A short note to the clinic in the person's words. Never health details.

tools.name: confirm_with_code
tools.description: Finish an action with the code the person received: book_appointment books the visit, find_my_bookings lists their coming bookings, join_waitlist files the request, send_inquiry sends the question to the clinic, request_demo sends the demo request, and buy_gift_card, register_for_event and order_products make the sale and answer with the payment link (also e-mailed; a free arrangement has none). Only the person can give the code; never guess one. Calling again with the same code answers with the same result.

confirmation_id.description: The confirmation_id the action answered with.

code.description: The code the person received and read out.

tools.name: find_my_bookings
tools.description: Send a code to the mobile number or email a person's bookings were made with; confirm_with_code then lists the coming bookings and gives a contact_proof for cancel_booking. Bookings in a GLØDI account are managed on Min side after signing in.

contact.description: The mobile number or email address the bookings were made with. The code goes there.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel one of the person's bookings with the contact_proof confirm_with_code gave, within the clinic's cancellation notice. Ask the person to confirm first. Nothing is refunded here; a paid visit is settled by the clinic.

tools.name: join_waitlist
tools.description: Put a person on the clinic's waiting list for one option when no free time suits: dates, parts of the day and a practitioner if wanted. A code goes to their phone, then confirm_with_code. The clinic sends an SMS when a time frees up; nothing is held.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

to_date.description: Last wanted day (YYYY-MM-DD); default two weeks on.

parts_of_day.description: morning (07-12), afternoon (12-17) or evening (17-22); omit for any time.

name.description: The person's full name, as they say it.

phone.description: The person's mobile number. The code goes there by SMS.

note.description: A short note to the clinic in the person's words. Never health details.

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description: Send one clinic a question or a call-back request for a person when a booking does not fit: a treatment the clinic books after a consultation, a question the facts do not answer, or "call me". Give clinic_id, the message in the person's words, their name and mobile number or email, and treatment_id when it is about one. A code goes to the person with the clinic's privacy notice; then confirm_with_code sends it to the clinic's inbox. The clinic contacts the person: never promise a time.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

message.description: The question or request in the person's own words.

treatment_id.description: The treatment it is about, from search_treatments.

callback.description: true: the person asks the clinic to call them back.

name.description: The person's full name, as they say it.

phone.description: The person's mobile number. The code goes there; without one, to the email.

preferred_contact.description: How the person wants the answer; a call-back is by phone.

tools.name: buy_gift_card
tools.description: Buy a gift card for a person, paid online: the clinic's own (clinic_id) or GLØDI's on glodi.no. Give the amount, the buyer's name, mobile number and e-mail, and the recipient if it is a present. A code goes to the buyer; confirm_with_code then answers with the payment link, also sent by e-mail. Nothing is paid until the person pays on that link.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

amount_nok.description: The gift card value in NOK.

recipient_email.description: Where the gift card is sent.

message.description: A greeting on the gift card.

payment_method.description: How the person pays on the payment link: card or Vipps.

name.description: The person's full name, as they say it.

phone.description: The person's mobile number. The code goes there by SMS.

email.description: The buyer's e-mail: the receipt and the payment link go there.

tools.name: register_for_event
tools.description: Register a person for an arrangement or course: session_id for one session or arrangement_id for the whole one (from list_events), pricing_tier_id when it has tiers, and the person's name, mobile number and e-mail. A code goes to the person; confirm_with_code registers them and, for a paid arrangement, answers with the payment link.

guests.description: People who come with the person (an open-house or time-slot arrangement); 0 for the person alone.

note.description: A short note to the clinic in the person's words. Never health details.

payment_method.description: How the person pays on the payment link: card or Vipps.

name.description: The person's full name, as they say it.

phone.description: The person's mobile number. The code goes there by SMS.

email.description: The person's e-mail: the confirmation and any payment link go there.

tools.name: order_products
tools.description: Order a clinic's products for pickup at the clinic, paid online: clinic_id and product_id with quantity from search_products, and the person's name, mobile number and e-mail. A code goes to the person; confirm_with_code orders and answers with the payment link.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

product_id.description: A product_id from search_products (the product slug).

items.description: The products, picked up at the clinic.

payment_method.description: How the person pays on the payment link: card or Vipps.

note.description: A short note to the clinic in the person's words. Never health details.

name.description: The person's full name, as they say it.

phone.description: The person's mobile number. The code goes there by SMS.

email.description: The person's e-mail: the order and the payment link go there.

tools.name: request_demo
tools.description: Ask the GLØDI team for a demo access code for a person interested in GLØDI: their name and email or mobile number. A code goes there, then confirm_with_code. The team answers by hand.

name.description: The person's full name, as they say it.

contact.description: An email address or a mobile number. The code goes there.
